response.reason: The rational-approximation coefficients have been truncated to ~4 significant figures (e.g. 194.6 vs the Cephes 194.96, 432.9 vs 432.96, 16.16 vs 16.1575...), which perturbs the correction term by roughly 1e-5 near the interval boundaries (|z|≈0.414), far exceeding the required absolute tolerance of 1e-6. The range-reduction structure (three intervals, π/2 and π/4 rebasing) is correct, but the coefficient rounding breaks the accuracy contract across the legal FP16 domain.
